name: Wins
tagline: Snap windows, preview open windows from the Dock, and switch between apps and windows.
description:
Wins brings window snapping and previews to the Mac desktop. It helps when you work with many open windows and need to arrange, locate, or switch to a specific one quickly.

## Features
- Place windows into common layouts with snapping and shortcuts.
- Preview open windows for a Dock app.
- Switch to an individual window with the keyboard and manage windows from Mission Control.

## Privacy and requirements
Window management features require access to macOS window controls. Dock previews can expose window contents while you share your screen.

## Pricing
Wins offers a trial. Single, Pro, and X are one-time licenses starting at $19.99. The developer also offers update renewals.
